title: Facebook Pixel
subtitle: Paste the academy's Facebook Pixel ID. With this we measure visits (PageView) and who registers (CompleteRegistration) for your campaigns.
notAllowed: Only an administrator can configure the Facebook Pixel.
label: Pixel ID
help: Find it in Facebook Events Manager → Data sources → your Pixel. Numbers only. Leave empty to disable it.
invalid: The Pixel ID must be numeric (6-20 digits).
saved: Pixel saved. It loads on every page.
capiPlaceholderSet: Already configured — paste a new one to replace it
capiHelp: Optional but recommended: with this token the registration is also sent server-side (Conversions API), so Meta counts it even if the browser blocks the pixel. Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the current one.
capiInvalid: The CAPI token looks too short.
